requirements.text: We are looking for a Founding Principal Engineer with 6+ years of experience, who will be working directly alongside the CEO to set the technical foundation for a pediatric mental health platform that's rebuilding care from the ground up. You'll be a product-minded, hands-on builder who thrives in early-stage environments and takes ownership of complex consumer products in a regulated space. We just raised our Series B and are replacing our offshore team with a small, exceptional in-house engineering org, and you'll be the one to define how it's built.
Recent early- stage/startup experience as senior or founding engineer
Production full- stack TypeScript (Node + React + AWS)
Product- minded: makes UX/feature decisions without detailed PRDs
